---
title: "Phase 5. Review"
description: "Ask whether it worked, is still right, and what comes next."
---

After delivery, review the analysis. Repeat the review on the cadence your level sets.

## What you do

{{< include /guidance/_partials/step-levels-key.qmd >}}
[From Level 3]{.pb-level} means Level 3 and above.

1. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Ask whether the analysis informed the decision** it was commissioned for.
2. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Ask whether it is still being used**, and still being used as specified.
3. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Ask whether it is still right.**
4. [From Level 3[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Check the assurance level still holds.** Score it again if it does not, and record the result.
5. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Decide whether to decommission it**, reissue it, or leave it as it is.
6. [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Record the lessons** where the next analyst will look for them. For a regular output, that is
   the analytical plan for the next cycle. Raise any that apply beyond this output with the people in
   [who to ask](../09-resources/r3-who-to-ask.qmd).
7. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **If the output is regular or ongoing, bring it to the monthly review meeting.** The Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead chairs it. See
   [the monthly review meeting](../09-resources/r18-review-reuse-and-records.qmd#the-monthly-review-meeting).

## When review happens, and who owns it

| Level | Trigger | Owner | Cadence |
|------------------|---------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------|
| Level 1 Standard | On request, or when the output changes | The analyst who produced it | At each reissue |
| Level 2 Enhanced | Scheduled | The commissioner, with the analyst | Annually, or at each reissue if more frequent, and before any reuse for a new purpose |
| Level 3 Comprehensive | Scheduled, and on any material change | The commissioner, with the analyst | Annually, and before any reuse for a new purpose |
| Level 4 BCA | Scheduled, and on any material change | The commissioner, with the Analysis Senior Responsible Officer | Annually, and before any reuse for a new purpose |

: When review is triggered, who owns it and how often, by assurance level

## What to check in a review

- **Decisions taken and policy changes informed.** Find what actually changed as a result of this
  analysis.
- **Usage.** Check downloads, page views, requests, onward citation, or whatever else the
  publication route records.
- **Ongoing usefulness.** Run user research with the people who use it, asking whether it still
  answers their question.
- **Case studies.** Write down how the data has been used, as it happens.
- **Trend changes.** Where the analysis was meant to change a trend, check whether the trend
  changed.
- **Improvements to regular analysis.** Note what the last run of this analysis showed could be
  better.
- **Decommissioning.** Stop producing analysis that is no longer useful.

## Check four things before any reuse {#check-four-things-before-any-reuse}

- Has the **population** the analysis covers changed, or is the new use about a different one?
- Has the **data** moved in coverage, definition or quality since?
- Is the **use case** different from the one the method was built to answer? A new audience is a
  different use case.
- Has the **decision context** shifted, so that the same output now carries more weight?

If any answer is yes, [score the assurance level again](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd). If every answer is no, the reuse goes ahead at the level the work already has. If an impact dimension scored 4, go to
[Business Critical analysis, step 8](../08-business-critical/index.qmd#step-8-keep-it-true-after-first-use).

## Outputs of this phase

- The review record, kept with the project record:
  - For most outputs, a short entry against the output in the analytical plan.
  - The entry says what was checked, what was found, what changed, and who was involved.
  - For Business Critical analysis, any agreed improvements go into the quality assurance plan, with their priorities and target dates.
- [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} The lessons, where the next piece of work will find them.
- [From Level 3[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} The assurance level, revalidated. For Business Critical work, the designation as well.
- A decommissioning decision, where one was taken.

## Lessons for the next piece of work

When you [scope the next piece of work](../01-engagement-and-scoping/index.qmd), look for relevant
lessons from earlier work. Capture new lessons as they happen.

## Who does what in this phase

| Role | In Phase 5 |
|---|---|
| **Analyst** | Record the lessons where the next analyst will look for them |
| **Critical friend** | No action in this phase. The lessons recorded here include your Phase 3 findings |
| **Commissioner** | Confirm whether it informed the decision, whether it is still used, and whether to decommission it |
| **Analysis Senior Responsible Officer** | Business Critical work only. Revalidate the designation annually, and before any reuse for a new purpose. Approve any new use before it goes ahead |
